description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipController class within the OrangeHRM system. It manages the employee membership view, including preparing data for rendering the employee membership component, and interacts with services to retrieve necessary information such as membership and currency arrays.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the employee membership view, preparing the Vue component with employee, membership, and currency data, and managing permissions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getMembershipService
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the MembershipService, instantiating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Returns the PayGradeService instance from the dependency container.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with employee membership data for rendering. If the employee number is present in the request, it sets up the component with data such as currencies, memberships, and paid-by options, and assigns permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Defines data groups required for capability checks, specifically for 'membership'.
